Oliveirense season | website = {{URL|http://www.udoliveirense.pt/}}| | pattern_la1 = _oliveirense1718h | pattern_b1 = _oliveirense1718h | pattern_ra1 = _oliveirense1718h | pattern_sh1 = _oliveirense1718h | pattern_so1 = _oliveirense1718h | leftarm1 = E93343 | body1 = E93343 | rightarm1 = E93343 | shorts1 = 206ECB | socks1 = E93343 | pattern_la2 = _oliveirense1718a | pattern_b2 = _oliveirense1718a | pattern_ra2 = _oliveirense1718a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} [[Image:Estadiocarlososorio.jpg|thumb|240px|right|Estádio Carlos Osório]] '''União Desportiva Oliveirense''' (UDO), commonly known as '''Oliveirense''', is a Portuguese [[sports club]] from the city of [[Oliveira de Azeméis]], in [[Aveiro District]].{{Cite web|title=Ud Oliveirense|url=https://www.fpf.pt/pt/Clubes/Detalhe-de-clube/Club/1406|website=FPF|access-date=2026-02-02|language=pt-PT}} The club was founded on 25 October 1922.{{cite news|url=http://www.udoliveirense.pt/clube.28.html|title=Clube|trans-title=Club|work=udoliveirense.pt|language=pt|date=15 July 2012|access-date=15 July 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120918071630/http://www.udoliveirense.pt/clube.28.html|archive-date=18 September 2012}} The main [[association football|football]] team currently plays at the Estádio Carlos Osório which holds a [[seating capacity]] of 1,750 and plays in [[Liga Portugal 2]]. As a multisports club it fields very successful teams in [[UD Oliveirense (rink hockey)|rink hockey]] and [[Oliveirense (basketball)|basketball]] as well.{{cite news|url=http://www.udoliveirense.pt/hoquei.4.html|title=Hoquei|trans-title=Hockey|work=udoliveirense.pt|language=pt|date=15 July 2012|access-date=15 July 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120226200617/http://www.udoliveirense.pt/hoquei.4.html|archive-date=26 February 2012}}{{cite news|url=http://www.udoliveirense.pt/basquetebol.1.html|title=Basquetebol|trans-title=Basketball|work=udoliveirense.pt|language=pt|date=15 July 2012|access-date=15 July 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120406002241/http://www.udoliveirense.pt/basquetebol.1.html|archive-date=6 April 2012}} Its [[Roller hockey (Quad)|rink hockey]] team has won the [[Portuguese Roller Hockey Cup|Taça de Portugal]] on three occasions whilst its [[basketball]] team has won the [[Portuguese Basketball SuperCup]] and the [[Portuguese Basketball Cup]].{{cite news|url=http://www.udoliveirense.pt/clube.28/palmares.116/palmares.a31.html|title=Palmarés|trans-title=Honours|work=udoliveirense.pt|language=pt|date=15 July 2012|access-date=15 July 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120918071737/http://www.udoliveirense.pt/clube.28/palmares.116/palmares.a31.html|archive-date=18 September 2012}} The [[Kelly–Simoldes–UDO]] cycling team, which holds a [[UCI Continental team]] licence, is affiliated with União Desportiva Oliveirense. Oliveirense is part of the [[Aveiro Football Association]] which is the football association in charge of the district's football matters.{{cite news |url=http://www.afaveiro.pt/?page_id=45 |title=SÓCIOS HONORÁRIOS|trans-title=Members|work=afaveiro.pt|language=pt| date=14 July 2012 |access-date=14 July 2012 }} In its entire history the club has won seven major trophies, of which their first was the [[Aveiro Football Association#District Championships|AF Aveiro Championship]] in the 1945–46 season.{{cite news |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesp/portregchamp.html |title=Aveiro|work=RSSSF|language=pt| date=14 July 2012 |access-date=14 July 2012 }} Oliveirense are currently sponsored by Italian sportswear manufacturer [[Macron (sportswear)|Macron]].{{cite web | title=Football—Teams | url=http://en.macron.com/Teams/Football | at=Portugal | access-date=28 April 2012 | url-status=dead | archive-date=13 April 2012 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120413102812/http://en.macron.com/Teams/Football }} The club is owned by Japanese restaurant operator Onodera Group, which is also the owner of [[Yokohama FC]].{{Cite web |title=Dono do Yokohama FC, do Japão, adquire 52,5% da SAD da Oliveirense |url=https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/2a-liga/noticias/dono-do-yokohama-fc-do-japao-adquire-525-da-sad-da-oliveirense-15318750.html |access-date=2023-02-01 |website=www.ojogo.pt |date=4 November 2022 |language=pt-PT |archive-date=2023-02-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230201114931/https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/2a-liga/noticias/dono-do-yokohama-fc-do-japao-adquire-525-da-sad-da-oliveirense-15318750.html |url-status=dead }}"}}
